title: Cybersecurity Professional
description:
**Job Title**: Cybersecurity Professional  
**Job Location**: Anywhere in India  
  
**Role Overview:**

As a Product and Solution Security Expert (PSSE) in Grid Software, you are the cybersecurity backbone for mission-critical Operational Technology (OT) deployments. You will act as the trusted security authority interfacing between our R&D organizations, project engineering teams, and major transmission/distribution system operators (TSOs/DSOs).

Your mission is to secure our advanced SCADA, ADMS, and grid automation solutions against evolving threat landscapes without compromising the strict availability and real-time performance demands of critical infrastructure. You will champion our security posture—safeguarding legacy integration layers while driving robust, secure architectures for modern deployments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Customer & Stakeholder Cybersecurity Leadership: Serve as the primary security interface for high-stakes customer projects, leading security alignment workshops, architecture reviews, and defending our security posture against rigorous customer specifications and regulatory frameworks (e.g., NIS2, IEC 62443).
* Secure Architecture & Integration: Oversee the secure design, hardening, and network segmentation of SCADA/EMS solutions deployed in customer environments. Ensure seamless integration of identity and access management (IAM), secure logging, and patch management workflows.
* Risk & Vulnerability Management: Apply our post-freeze risk scorecard methodologies. Evaluate 3rd-party software vulnerabilities using Environmental CVSS, reachability analysis (VEX), and exploit probability (EPSS/KEV) to advise Project Managers and Product Security Officers (PSSOs) on risk-based release decisions.
* Compliance & Certification Support: Drive adherence to IEC 62443-3-3 standards across project lifecycles, preparing documentation, security targets, and evidence for customer audits and factory/site acceptance tests (FAT/SAT).
* Incident Preparedness & Incident Engineering: Collaborate with project teams and incident response units to define fail-open contingency designs, ensuring grid availability takes precedence while containment and remediation occur safely.

**Key Deliverables:**

1. Project Security Architecture & Risk Assessments: Comprehensive security design documents, threat models (STRIDE), and system-specific risk assessments for every assigned critical infrastructure project.

2. Security-Gate Sign-offs: Authoritative security reviews and gate approvals at key project milestones (Architecture, FAT, SAT, Go-Live), backed by quantified risk-mitigation plans.

3. Vulnerability & Patch Management Runbooks: Tailored operational guidelines and risk-scoring rationales for customers handling 3rd-party component patching in live SCADA environments.

4. Regulatory & Audit Artifacts: Audit-ready compliance packages mapping project implementations to IEC 62443 and national critical infrastructure protection (CIP) standards.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* Zero Unmitigated Critical Exposures: High-risk vulnerabilities and architectural gaps are identified, triaged, and mitigated proactively before system integration or customer sign-off.
* Trusted Advisor Status: You earn the absolute confidence of customer CISOs and Bid- and Project Managers by explaining complex OT cybersecurity trade-offs with clarity, pragmatism, and authority.
* Resilient Delivery Without Compromise: Grid availability and performance are never sacrificed; your security frameworks ensure that fail-open mechanisms and robust risk management protect the grid while maintaining operational uptime.
* Seamless Collaboration: Engineering teams, PSSOs, and external partners view you not as a compliance bottleneck, but as an enabler who embeds security cleanly into the delivery lifecycle.

**Qualifications:**

* Degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity within Industrial Control Systems (ICS), SCADA, or critical infrastructure sectors.
* Deep working knowledge of IEC 62443, NERC CIP, and European cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NIS2, CRA).
* Hands-on experience with threat modeling, secure network architectures (Purdue Model, firewalls, datadiodes), Identiy and Access Management concepts and vulnerability triaging tools.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills in English

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**Role Summary**

This is a core investigative role on the team responsible for handling customer cybersecurity incidents — offering a unique opportunity to fight threat actors at scale. The job is investigation: driving incidents from raw log data to a defensible account of what actually happened, what the threat actor touched, and what was at risk. We want a strong, independent analyst — someone who runs to the data, builds a solid timeline from imperfect evidence, and doesn't need a senior sitting next to them to get to the answer on a well-understood incident. We are looking for people who raise the bar — if you see a broken process, you fix it; if you encounter a repetitive task, you automate it. The right person is comfortable veering from the documented playbook when an incident's attributes don't fit it — and disciplined enough to document why. Operational coordination and customer work sit on top of that investigative foundation. If you want to be right in the middle of the action fighting threat actors at scale, this is where you want to be. If you can own an investigation end-to-end and know when a case is genuinely novel enough to pull in help, this role is built for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the analysis on investigations independently — take multi-source datasets (Splunk, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM (NG-SIEM), SQL) and reconstruct what the threat actor did, what they accessed, and what was at risk, across varying Salesforce products.
* Adapt the investigative approach when standard playbook procedures don't map cleanly to the incident — document the deviation and the rationale rather than working around it silently.
* Perform log analysis independently: multi-source joins, regex parsing, and hypothesis-driven pivoting across data sources — needing no assistance beyond peer review.

* Identify procedural gaps or friction during investigations — actively documenting updates to fix broken processes and automating repetitive workflows.
* Complete AppExchange audits and ISV investigations without senior supervision on standard cases.
* Share knowledge with the team on a regular cadence — case walkthroughs, team presentations, or documentation contributions.
* Support our AI-first initiatives — use and help improve automated agents for triage, documentation, and investigation workflows.
Build working relationships across ITM/SSRC — Detection, Product Security, Legal — and leverage them to accelerate incident resolution.

* Strong, independent analytical skill under pressure. Demonstrated ability to take multi-source data and produce a correct, defensible account of incidents without hand-holding.
* Proficient log analysis — Splunk, CrowdStrike Falcon Next-Gen SIEM (NG-SIEM), and SQL, including multi-source joins and regex parsing — performed independently, with no more than peer review.
* Hands-on threat hunting — able to run hypothesis-driven hunts across large security datasets (NG-SIEM, Splunk) to surface malicious activity that isn't yet alerting, and pivot what you find into an active investigation.
* Solid hands-on experience with Account Takeover, credential compromise, data exfiltration, and API abuse incidents.

**Job Description\***


The IAM Analyst (Mainframe Provisioning and Security) is responsible for administering and governing user, privileged, service, and technical identities across the mainframe environment, including RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS, and related security domains. The role ensures timely, accurate, and risk\-aligned access provisioning, de\-provisioning, role maintenance, and entitlement administration in accordance with enterprise IAM policies, segregation of duties, and regulatory requirements.


This role partners with Lines of Business, account owners, and infrastructure teams to deliver secure access lifecycle management for critical mainframe resources. * Administer and govern mainframe identities and access across RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS, datasets, groups, resource classes, started tasks, and privileged accounts, ensuring least privilege and policy compliance.

* Manage access for sensitive mainframe resources including dataset profiles, generic profiles, groups, OMVS segments, USS access, surrogate access, and command/resource controls.
* Handle escalations, exception requests, urgent access restorations, and complex provisioning scenarios across multiple LPARs and environments while maintaining control evidence and operational discipline.
* Drive process improvement and automation using JCL, REXX, Shell, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting where applicable, reducing manual processing and improving control consistency.
* Develop and maintain operational scripts, batch workflows, and JCL\-based utilities for bulk updates, reconciliation, reporting, evidence collection, and controlled remediation activities.
* Ensure secure administration of privileged, emergency, and non\-human accounts by applying strong controls for ownership, monitoring, authentication, and decommissioning.
* Perform timely de\-provisioning and access removals and ensuring stale access, orphan IDs, and toxic combinations are identified and remediated.
* Create and maintain standard operating procedures, and technical documentation for provisioning workflows, command execution standards, and automated jobs.
* Partner with security and platform teams to strengthen the mainframe control environment through continuous monitoring, metrics, control testing and strategic modernization initiatives.

**Education\*** BE/BTECH/MCA/MSC (IT) equivalent (Any Technical Degree)

* IBM Security zSecure, RACF administration, SailPoint, CyberArk etc.
* Governance, risk, or audit\-aligned certifications such as CRISC, CISM, or CISA are also desirable.

* Strong understanding of IAM architecture, access lifecycle management, RBAC, privileged access concepts, segregation of duties, and risk\-based control frameworks.
* Deep knowledge of mainframe security administration across RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS/USS, and familiarity with ACF2 or Top Secret concepts in multi\-platform environments.
* Hands\-on experience with automation and scripting such as JCL, REXX, Shell, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent tools used for provisioning, reconciliation, reporting, and workflow optimization.
* Experience with bulk data handling, evidence preparation, and reporting using Excel, macros, or data analysis tooling for operational and audit support.

* Ability to adapt to evolving security tools, AI\-assisted operational capabilities, and changing regulatory or control expectations in a high\-risk environment.
* Experience working in a cross\-functional, team\-oriented environment involving IAM, infrastructure \& platform security.
* Self\-starter with strong troubleshooting capability, operational ownership, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a time\-sensitive provisioning environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret access models, troubleshoot security errors, and identify process or control gaps.
* Demonstrated risk\-oriented mindset with experience supporting access reviews, audit responses, issue remediation, control validation, and policy compliance.
* Good interpersonal and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across global teams and Lines of Business.
* Ability to provide senior\-level judgment, mentor junior analysts, and influence process and control improvements across the provisioning function.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and reporting tools, especially Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Visio, for analysis, communication, documentation, and control evidence preparation.

**Desired skills**

* Strong technical knowledge of RACF administration, resource class security, dataset protection, OMVS/USS, z/VM concepts, JCL, and familiarity with tools such as zSecure.

title: Cloud Security Analyst
description:
About Us:

Seismic is the Go\-To\-Market Performance company, driving how organizations turn their strategy into revenue. Seismic brings together signals from customer conversations, buyer engagement, governed content, coaching and seller behavior to turn intelligence into winning action. Through its AI revenue execution platform, the company equips customer\-facing teams with the insights, governance, and contextual guidance they need to execute with confidence and deliver measurable business outcomes. Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3\.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia\-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.  

Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
Overview:

As a Cloud Analyst supporting the Seismic product suite, you will help us secure our cloud footprint across five cloud providers and a wide array of delivery stacks. You will help us strengthen our monitoring capabilities, develop common controls across all systems, measure implementations against industry benchmarks, and help us to protect our customers against emerging threats – including agentic AI risk. Sitting at the intersection of security operations and cloud platform engineering, you will build automated controls, triage alerts, address toil, and partner with our product engineering team to solve problems.  


Who you are::
* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps, or Infrastructure Security.
* Capable of managing cloud posture , reviewing CIS Benchmarks, and working with security logging/SIEM solutions.
* Hands\-on experience configuring and tuning WAF policies and rules (e.g. Cloudflare WAF, AWS WAF).
* Experience with Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform) for audit and remediation.
* Proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar language for fetching telemetry, interacting with cloud APIs, and automating security tasks.
* Experienced with least\-privilege principles, service accounts, API key lifecycles, and machine\-to\-machine authentication.

**Nice to Have (Optional)**  

* Experience with GCP, OCI, or posture management.
* Experience with SOAR platforms and automated security workflows (e.g. Workato, Tines).
* Knowledge of detection engineering fundamentals, rule authoring, and threat intelligence.
* Exposure to security AI/ML workloads, agentic AI frameworks, non\-human identity management, or automated API integrations.
* Relevant industry certifications (e.g. AWS Certified Security, Azure Security Engineer Associate, Security\+, CCSP or other relevant specialty certifications).

  


What you'll be doing::
* **Identity \& Agentic AI Security** Enforce identity, access, and privilege boundaries for automated agents, service accounts, and API integrations interacting with cloud infrastructure.
* **Cloud Infrastructure Monitoring** Build, tune, and maintain security monitoring across our Cloudflare Web Application Firewall (WAF), Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), and cloud\-focused SIEM logs. Work to reduce alerts, improve remediation times, and create runbooks for standardized responses.
* **Hardening \& Compliance**: Conduct regular CIS Benchmark audits across cloud environments, identify posture drift, and collaborate with teams to remediate findings.
* **Automation \& Scripting**: Write clean scripts (AI skills, Python, Bash, etc.) to automate alert triage, remediate misconfigurations, and integrate security tooling into existing workflows.
* **Cloud Security Operations \& Escalation**: Own escalation paths for cloud security alerts, participate in incident investigation, root\-cause analysis, and post\-incident documentation.
* **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**: Collaborate with Cloud Security Engineering and Cloud Operations to advance shared security objectives through clear ownership, effective prioritization, transparent ticketing, and timely resolution.
* **Culture \& Global Alignment**: Gain experience and mentorship from seasoned security professionals and contribute to a growing and collaborative global security team.
